resources.string: The one permission capture cannot run without
The radio\'s audio arrives through the phone\'s audio input, so Android treats it as recording. The app will ask you for microphone access next.
Audio is stored on this phone, losslessly, and nowhere else.
The next step verifies the audio is the radio, not this phone\'s own mic. Capture halts if it is not.
Choose While using the app. \"Only this time\" ends an overnight run at the first restart.
\"Don\'t allow\" was chosen twice, so the prompt is gone. The permission can only be granted from the system settings now. Nothing else in setup can proceed until it is.
Microphone → Allow only while using the app
Come back — this screen checks again on its own
The microphone is how the radio\'s audio reaches the app. It is never used for anything else, and the next step proves the audio is the radio, not the room.
One persistent notification, so you can always see it is running
Capture runs as a foreground service. Android requires it to show a notification while it does, and that notification is how you check the state from the lock screen.
You can skip this. Capture still runs, but you will not see it is running without opening the app, and the OS is more likely to end it.
